newsitem.title: MEXICO: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Weekly Mexican export, import feeder summary-USDA.

text.p: USDA said Friday that about 8000 steer claves and yearlings were exported to the United States from Mexico in the past week.

Feeder exports for the week were estimated at 8,000 head into the states of Texas and New Mexico. Confirmed exports for the previous week totaled 10,497 head, against 3,529 head in the same week in 1996, the USDA said.
Exports were mainly large 1 and 2 steers weighing 300-600 lbs. USDA said about 60 percent of supply was retained by owners or previously sold on video.
Imports into Mexico were estimated to have totaled 2,500 head for the week, it added.
Prices for medium and large 1 feeder steers weighing 300-400 lb were 94-104 cents/lb, for 400-500 lb were 84-94 cents/lb and for 500-600 lb were 80-84 cents/lb.
